name: Cafe Del Mar
notes: 5 photos: photo 1 is a digital dinner-menu screen with a ghosted double-exposure of another menu behind it (still legible); photo 2 is a digital breakfast-menu screen; photos 3-5 are a newer printed lunch/dinner card and a printed breakfast card with updated prices for several of the same dishes. Used the printed cards' prices where an item recurs on both the screen and the printed menu, and kept items unique to the screen menus. Coffee, espresso, smoothie and soda lines were skipped as drinks, not dishes; bread/cheese/sauce build-your-own components were skipped as modifiers.
